description.content: Performs a complex query against the ConceptNet edge store using any combination of start, end, rel, node, other, and sources parameters. All parameters are optional but at least one must be provided. Results are returned as a paginated JSON-LD edge list. This is the most flexible endpoint for slicing the knowledge graph by subject, object, relation type, or data source simultaneously.

query.description: ConceptNet URI for the subject (start) node of edges
ConceptNet URI for the object (end) node of edges
Relation URI to filter by (e.g. /r/IsA or /r/UsedFor)
URI matching either the start or end position of edges. Cannot be combined with the "other" parameter using the same URI.
URI matching the position opposite to "node". Used together with "node" to find edges where node appears on one side and other appears on the other.
Source URI to restrict results to a specific data source
Number of results to skip for pagination (0-100000)
Maximum number of results to return (0-1000)

response.name: Paginated list of matching edges

description.content:
ConceptNet is a freely available multilingual knowledge graph providing computers access to common-sense knowledge. The REST API exposes the full ConceptNet 5 knowledge graph via JSON-LD endpoints. Consumers can look up concept nodes by language and term, query edges by relation type, retrieve semantically related terms ranked by Numberbatch embedding similarity, compute pairwise relatedness scores between concepts, and normalize natural-language text into canonical ConceptNet URIs. No authentication or API key is required.
